newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai in HK$60 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai in HK$60 mln rights issue.

text.p: Finance concern First Shanghai Investments Ltd plans to raise HK$60.5 million before expenses by a rights issue of 172.99 million new shares at HK$0.35 per rights shares, it said in a statement published on Monday.
The company said the rights shares would be alloted on the basis of two rights shares for every five existing shares held.
Its shares ended at HK$0.475 each on Friday. Book closing for the rights issue of shares will be from October 14 to 17.
The company's managing director Lao Yuan-yi said HK$33.54 million of the proceeds would be used to repay short-term bank borrowings and the balance was earmarked for working capital.
First Shanghai is engaged in share investment and stockbroking, general insurance, finance, deposit-taking and banking services.
Earlier this month, the company reported an interim loss of HK$3.44 million for the first half of 1996, compared with a HK$6.31 million loss in the year earlier period.
It also said it would buy a 33.01 percent stake in a China child products manufacturing and distributing venture, Goodbaby Child Products Co Ltd, for US$6.9 million.
